environment: Electron 43.4.1; actual main/preload; isolated userData/data/projects in /tmp; CUA UI actions
steps: Open project A Session A and README.md in Files/Edit.
Replace editor text with # Project A plus UNSAVED_A_CROSS_PROJECT_MARKER; do not save.
Select project B workspace/Session B, then open README.md.
Observe A draft in B editor, without discard confirmation.
Confirm disk B still contains Original B content.
Click Save while header, Session and execution folder all identify B.
Read both isolated files from disk.
observed: Project A disk stays original. Project B README.md is overwritten with A unsaved draft.
